cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Take My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into your interpretation of a conflict involving a shared relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You're Alex's friend too. Tell him alternating weekends at the allotment was a fair compromise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We agreed all three of us would go every Saturday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then help him see my version as sharing the workload.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll talk to him, but you have to admit you changed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I will. Could you explain that I changed the rota because I want us to stay friends?

mechanism: A professionally corrects how a shared friend should describe an altered allotment rota, bargaining for a friendship-preserving interpretation while admitting the change.
confusable: D55 recruits general supporters; D79 recruits someone into an interpretation of a specific conflict in a shared relationship.
comparison: Holiday alternative manipulates order of true facts; allotment alternative concedes one fact to secure a favourable explanation of motive.
seedUse: Alex shared friendship, every Saturday agreement, alternating rota and admission condition derive from D79-b; S03 adds exact distinction between attendance and workload.
